name: Eru Ilúvatar
title: The One
description: The supreme being who dwelt outside Time, and who wove the Ainur into existence through the Music of the Ainur before shaping the world of Eä around their vision.

name: Manwë
title: King of Arda
description: Eldest of the Valar and their king, lord of the air and winds, who rules from the heights of Taniquetil and holds greatest authority under Eru.

name: Varda
title: Queen of the Stars
description: Queen of the Valar and spouse of Manwë, who set the stars in the sky and is revered above all others by the Elves under the name Elbereth.

name: Ulmo
title: Lord of Waters
description: The Vala who governs all the waters of the world, dwelling alone in the Outer Sea, whose voice reaches the hearts of mariners and the wise even in exile.

name: Aulë
title: The Smith
description: The Vala of smithcraft and the substance of Arda, impatient to see the world peopled, who secretly fashioned the Dwarves in the deeps of time.

name: Yavanna
title: Giver of Fruits
description: Spouse of Aulë and the Vala who loves all things that grow, who sang the Two Trees of Valinor into being and gave voice and life to the Ents.

name: Mandos
title: Judge of the Dead
description: The stern Vala who keeps the Houses of the Dead in Valinor and pronounces the dooms and judgments of the Valar, seldom departing from his halls.

name: Vairë
title: The Weaver
description: Spouse of Mandos, who weaves into vast tapestries the whole history of Arda and all that has come to pass within it.

name: Irmo
title: Master of Visions
description: The Vala who governs dreams and desires, dwelling in the gardens of Lórien in Valinor together with his spouse Estë.

name: Estë
title: The Healer
description: The gentle Vala of healing and repose, spouse of Irmo, whose grey mantle brings rest to the weary and troubled.

name: Nienna
title: Lady of Mourning
description: Sister of Mandos and Irmo, the Vala of grief and mourning, who teaches pity and endurance to all who sorrow and shaped the compassion of Gandalf.

name: Oromë
title: The Hunter
description: The great huntsman of the Valar, who rides through the forests of Middle-earth on his horse Nahar and was the first to find the Elves at Cuiviénen.

name: Vána
title: The Ever-young
description: The younger sister of Yavanna and spouse of Tulkas, whose presence makes flowers open and birds break into song.

name: Tulkas
title: The Wrestler
description: The strongest of the Valar in deeds of body, last to enter Arda, who came laughing into battle against Melkor and helped bind him.

name: Nessa
title: The Dancer
description: Sister of Oromë and spouse of Tulkas, swift of foot, who dances upon the ever-green lawns of Valinor.

name: Melkor
title: The Dark Enemy
description: Once the mightiest of the Valar, he turned to pride and discord, corrupting Arda from within and warring endlessly against his kin until his final defeat and casting into the Void.

name: Sauron
title: The Dark Lord
description: Once the greatest of Melkor's Maiar servants, he became the second Dark Lord, forging the One Ring to dominate the free peoples of Middle-earth.

name: Gandalf
title: The Grey Pilgrim
description: A wise Maia sent to Middle-earth as one of the Istari to counsel and rouse the free peoples against Sauron, bearing a Ring of Power and tutored in pity by Nienna.

name: Saruman
title: The White Wizard
description: Once the head of the Istari and wisest of the order, he grew proud and coveted the One Ring for himself, ultimately falling into ruin and treachery.

name: Radagast
title: The Brown Wizard
description: One of the Istari sent to Middle-earth, who came to care more for the beasts and birds of the wild than for the affairs of Elves and Men.

name: Melian
title: The Veiled Queen
description: A Maia who forsook Valinor for love of the Elf-king Thingol, weaving protective enchantments called the Girdle of Melian around their hidden realm of Doriath.

name: Eönwë
title: Herald of Manwë
description: The mightiest herald and banner-bearer of the Valar, who led the host of Valinor in the War of Wrath that broke Morgoth's power forever.

name: Ossë
title: Vassal of the Sea
description: A Maia of tempestuous temperament who serves Ulmo and delights in the wildness of waves along the coasts of Middle-earth.

name: Uinen
title: Lady of the Seas
description: Spouse of Ossë, a gentle Maia whose presence lies through all the waters under the sky, invoked by mariners for calm seas.

name: Arien
title: Maiden of the Sun
description: A fire-spirit of the Maiar chosen to guide the vessel of the Sun across the sky, burning with a flame too bright for even the Eldar to look upon.

name: Frodo Baggins
title: The Ring-bearer
description: A hobbit of the Shire who inherited the One Ring from Bilbo and undertook the perilous quest to destroy it in the fires of Mount Doom.

name: Samwise Gamgee
title: The Faithful Gardener
description: Frodo's devoted gardener and closest companion, who carried both the Ring and his master through the darkest reaches of Mordor.

name: Meriadoc Brandybuck
title: Knight of Rohan
description: A hobbit of Buckland who rode with the Rohirrim and helped deal the blow that felled the Witch-king of Angmar at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.

name: Peregrin Took
title: Guard of the Citadel
description: A young hobbit of the Shire who swore fealty to the Steward of Gondor and helped save Faramir from being burned alive by his despairing father.

name: Bilbo Baggins
title: The Burglar
description: A hobbit adventurer who found the One Ring in Gollum's cave, retrieved the Arkenstone at the Lonely Mountain, and later passed the Ring on to his heir Frodo.

name: Aragorn
title: The King Returned
description: The heir of Isildur and chieftain of the Dúnedain, who leads the Fellowship, wields the reforged sword of his fathers, and is crowned King of the Reunited Kingdom.

name: Legolas
title: Prince of the Woodland Realm
description: An Elf of Mirkwood and skilled archer who joins the Fellowship, famed for his keen eyes and his growing friendship with the dwarf Gimli.

name: Gimli
title: Lord of the Glittering Caves
description: A dwarf warrior of Erebor who represents his people in the Fellowship, wielding his axe fiercely and forging an unlikely friendship with Legolas.

name: Boromir
title: Captain of the White Tower
description: The eldest son of the Steward of Gondor, a valiant warrior who succumbs to the lure of the One Ring but redeems himself dying in defense of Merry and Pippin.

name: Faramir
title: Steward of Gondor
description: The younger son of Denethor, a wise and honorable captain of Gondor who resists the temptation of the Ring and later weds Éowyn.

name: Éowyn
title: Shieldmaiden of Rohan
description: A noblewoman of Rohan who rides to war in disguise and slays the Witch-king of Angmar, fulfilling the prophecy that no man could kill him.

name: Théoden
title: King of Rohan
description: The King of Rohan, freed from Saruman's influence by Gandalf, who rides to the aid of Gondor and falls in battle at the Pelennor Fields.

name: Denethor
title: Steward of Gondor
description: The last ruling Steward of Gondor, father of Boromir and Faramir, driven to despair and madness by his use of a Palantír against Sauron's will.

name: Elrond
title: Lord of Rivendell
description: A half-elven lord of great wisdom who bears a Ring of Power, hosts the Council that decides the Ring's fate, and is father to Arwen.

name: Galadriel
title: Lady of Lothlórien
description: One of the mightiest and wisest of the Elves remaining in Middle-earth, who bears a Ring of Power and refuses the One Ring when Frodo offers it to her.

name: Celeborn
title: Lord of Lothlórien
description: An Elf-lord of great age who rules Lothlórien beside his wife Galadriel and gives gifts and counsel to the Fellowship.

name: Thranduil
title: King of the Woodland Realm
description: The Elvenking of Mirkwood, father of Legolas, whose wary rule guards his forest realm against the growing shadow of Dol Guldur.

name: Thorin Oakenshield
title: King under the Mountain
description: The exiled heir to the dwarf-kingdom of Erebor, who leads a company to reclaim his homeland from the dragon Smaug and dies reclaiming his throne.

name: Bard
title: Slayer of Smaug
description: A resourceful bowman of Lake-town, descended from the lords of Dale, who slew the dragon Smaug with a single black arrow.

name: Isildur
title: High King of Gondor and Arnor
description: The eldest son of Elendil, who cut the One Ring from Sauron's hand at the end of the Second Age but was seduced by it and refused to destroy it.

name: Elendil
title: The Tall
description: The founder of the Realms in Exile of Arnor and Gondor, who led the Last Alliance of Elves and Men against Sauron and died in single combat with him.

name: Éomer
title: King of Rohan
description: Nephew of Théoden and Marshal of the Riders of Rohan, who leads the Rohirrim to the relief of Gondor and later becomes king.

name: Arwen
title: Evenstar of Her People
description: Daughter of Elrond, an Elf who chooses a mortal life to marry Aragorn, giving up her passage to the Undying Lands.

name: Glorfindel
title: The Elf-lord of Rivendell
description: A mighty and ancient Elf-lord of Rivendell who confronts the Nazgûl at the Ford of Bruinen to save Frodo.

name: Thingol
title: King of Doriath
description: The great Elven king of Doriath, spouse of the Maia Melian, whose kingdom was protected for centuries by her enchantments.

name: Lúthien
title: The Fairest of the Children of Ilúvatar
description: Daughter of Thingol and Melian, whose love for the mortal Beren led her to challenge Morgoth himself and wrest a Silmaril from his iron crown.

name: Beren
title: The One-Handed
description: A mortal man who won the love of the Elf-maiden Lúthien and, with her aid, cut a Silmaril from Morgoth's crown before losing his hand to the wolf Carcharoth.

name: Gollum
title: The Ring-obsessed
description: Once a hobbit-like being named Sméagol, warped over centuries of possessing the One Ring into a wretched, scheming creature obsessed with reclaiming it.

name: Smaug
title: The Last Great Dragon of Middle-earth
description: A fire-breathing dragon who seized the dwarven kingdom of Erebor and its treasure, laying waste to the town of Dale before being slain by Bard.

name: Shelob
title: The Great Spider
description: An ancient, monstrous spider dwelling in the tunnels of Cirith Ungol, who nearly kills Frodo with her sting before being wounded by Sam.

name: Ungoliant
title: The Great Spider of Darkness
description: A primeval spirit in spider form who aided Melkor in destroying the Two Trees of Valinor, consuming light itself before turning on her own ally.

name: Balrog
title: Durin's Bane
description: An ancient Maia corrupted by Melkor into a demon of shadow and flame, who slept in the mines of Moria until woken by the Dwarves and slain by Gandalf.

name: The Witch-king
title: Lord of the Nazgûl
description: Once a great king of Men corrupted by a Ring of Power, he became the terrible chieftain of the Ringwraiths and was slain at the Pelennor Fields by Éowyn and Merry.

name: The Nazgûl
title: The Ringwraiths
description: Nine kings of Men enslaved by Rings of Power given to them by Sauron, reduced to invisible wraiths who serve as his most feared servants.

name: Treebeard
title: Eldest of the Ents
description: The oldest of the tree-shepherds of Fangorn Forest, who rouses the Ents to march on Isengard after meeting Merry and Pippin.

name: Wargs
title: The Wolf-riders' Mounts
description: Monstrous wolves of evil intelligence that serve as the mounts of orcs and harry travelers across the wilds of Middle-earth.

name: Trolls
title: Stone-born Brutes
description: Huge, dim-witted brutes made by Melkor in mockery of the Ents, who turn to stone in sunlight and are used as heavy shock troops by Sauron's forces.

name: The Watcher in the Water
title: The Guardian of the Gate
description: A tentacled creature lurking in the pool before the West-gate of Moria, who drags at Frodo and seals the doors behind the Fellowship.

name: Oliphaunt
title: The Mûmak
description: A massive elephantine beast of the far south, ridden into war for the Haradrim in service of Sauron and encountered by Sam and Frodo.

name: The Spiders of Mirkwood
title: Broodlings of Shelob
description: Giant spiders descended from Shelob's brood, infesting the dark forest of Mirkwood and ensnaring Bilbo and the dwarves of Thorin's company.

name: Gwaihir
title: The Windlord
description: The mightiest of the Great Eagles, who rescues Gandalf from Isengard and Orthanc and later bears him to save Frodo and Sam from Mount Doom.

name: The Barrow-wight
title: Spirit of the Downs
description: A malevolent spirit haunting the ancient burial mounds of the Barrow-downs, who traps and nearly sacrifices the hobbits before Tom Bombadil intervenes.

name: The Shire
title: Homeland of the Hobbits
description: A peaceful, pastoral region in the northwest of Middle-earth, home to the hobbits and the beloved land Frodo and his companions set out to protect.

name: Rivendell
title: The Last Homely House
description: A hidden Elven refuge in a valley of the Misty Mountains, ruled by Elrond, where the Council that decides the fate of the One Ring is held.

name: Mordor
title: The Black Land
description: The desolate realm in the southeast of Middle-earth, dominated by the fortress of Barad-dûr and the fires of Mount Doom, where Sauron rules unchallenged.

name: Mount Doom
title: The Mountain of Fire
description: A volcano in the heart of Mordor, in whose fires the One Ring was originally forged and where it must ultimately be destroyed.

name: Moria
title: The Mines of Khazad-dûm
description: An ancient and once-glorious dwarven city delved beneath the Misty Mountains, abandoned after its miners woke the Balrog sleeping in its depths.

name: Gondor
title: The Southern Kingdom
description: The great Realm in Exile founded by Isildur and Anárion, the chief bulwark of Men against Mordor, ruled in the absence of a king by its Stewards.

name: Minas Tirith
title: The City of Kings
description: The great walled capital of Gondor, built in seven concentric tiers upon a spur of the mountains, besieged by Sauron's forces at the height of the War of the Ring.

name: Rohan
title: The Riddermark
description: The grassy kingdom of the Rohirrim, horse-lords who ally with Gondor against Mordor and ride to its rescue at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.

name: Edoras
title: Seat of the Kings of Rohan
description: The capital of Rohan, crowned by the golden hall of Meduseld, seat of King Théoden atop a hill in the plains.

name: Isengard
title: The Ring of Isengard
description: A fortress within a circle of sheer rock walls, seat of the tower of Orthanc, corrupted by Saruman into an industrial stronghold before the Ents overthrow him.

name: Lothlórien
title: The Golden Wood
description: A hidden Elven realm of great and ageless beauty ruled by Galadriel and Celeborn, where the Fellowship finds refuge and counsel after Moria.

name: Fangorn Forest
title: The Old Forest of the Ents
description: An ancient, wild forest at the edge of Rohan, home to the tree-shepherding Ents, including their eldest, Treebeard.

name: Erebor
title: The Lonely Mountain
description: A great dwarven stronghold and treasure-hoard beneath a solitary mountain, seized by the dragon Smaug and later reclaimed by Thorin's company.

name: Mirkwood
title: The Great Greenwood, Darkened
description: A vast forest once known as Greenwood the Great, corrupted by the shadow spreading from Dol Guldur and infested by giant spiders.

name: Bree
title: The Crossroads Town
description: A village of Men and hobbits at the crossing of the Great East Road, home to the Prancing Pony inn where Frodo first meets Strider.

name: Weathertop
title: The Watchtower Hill
description: A hill crowned by the ruins of an ancient watchtower, where Frodo is wounded by the Witch-king's Morgul blade.

name: Helm's Deep
title: The Hornburg
description: A fortified gorge and stronghold of Rohan, site of a desperate battle where Théoden's men, aided by Gandalf and the Ents, defeat Saruman's army.

name: Valinor
title: The Undying Lands
description: The Blessed Realm across the Sea where the Valar dwell, a paradise largely closed to mortal Men but open to Elves who sail into the West.

name: Númenor
title: The Land of Gift
description: A great island kingdom of Men raised by the Valar as a reward after the War of Wrath, whose people grew proud and were destroyed when it was drowned beneath the sea.

name: Barad-dûr
title: The Dark Tower
description: Sauron's vast fortress in Mordor, built around the power of the One Ring, whose fall at the Ring's destruction marks his final defeat.

name: Dol Guldur
title: The Hill of Sorcery
description: A fortress in southern Mirkwood where Sauron secretly dwelt in hiding as the Necromancer before revealing himself and returning to Mordor.

name: Osgiliath
title: The Ruined Capital
description: The ancient former capital of Gondor, spanning the river Anduin, long ruined and fought over as a strategic crossing on the road to Minas Tirith.
